access.notes: PBEsol pseudopotentials are included in the standard library. Use version 6.x or later.
Requires PhonoPy. Open-source package for anharmonic force constants and lattice thermal conductivity.
Geller & Wood (1954). Lattice parameter a0=4.675 Å, space group P2_13, x_Rh=0.144, x_Si=0.840. Used as initial geometry before DFT relaxation.
Schubert (1947). Lattice parameter a0=5.122 Å, space group P2_13. Internal coordinates from DFT-relaxed values in the paper may be used as starting point.
